name: Prompt Engineering & Context Construction
description: Systematic prompt design, in-context learning, reasoning frameworks (CoT, ToT, ReAct), few-shot exemplar curation, dynamic prompt templating, metaprompts, automated prompt optimization (DSPy), and output calibration.

subskills.name: Zero-Shot & Few-Shot In-Context Learning
subskills.description: Structuring zero-shot prompts, authoring system instructions, role conditioning, and selecting balanced few-shot exemplars with clear input-output boundaries.

subskills.name: Dynamic Prompt Templating (Jinja2 & LangChain)
subskills.description: Authoring dynamic and reusable prompt templates with variable injection, partial formatting, Jinja2 conditional rendering, and LangChain/LlamaIndex ChatPromptTemplate.

subskills.name: Output Formatting & Delimiter Engineering
subskills.description: Enforcing output format adherence (Markdown, XML tags, YAML, JSON) using structural delimiters (```, <instructions>, <context>), avoiding markdown fences leakage, and negative constraints.

subskills.name: Chain-of-Thought & Self-Consistency Reasoning
subskills.description: Implementing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting ('Think step-by-step'), Least-to-Most prompting, and Self-Consistency decoding with majority voting across multiple sample paths.
keywords: zero-shot CoT ('Let's think step by step')

subskills.name: Tree of Thoughts (ToT) & Graph Reasoning
subskills.description: Designing multi-path exploration and heuristic search reasoning architectures: Tree of Thoughts (ToT), Graph of Thoughts (GoT), thought generation, evaluation states, and backtracking.

subskills.name: Enterprise Metaprompting & System Prompt Design
subskills.description: Architecting comprehensive enterprise metaprompts, role definitions, tone of voice, tool-use guidance, fallback policies, context budget allocation, and self-correcting prompt instructions.

subskills.name: Automated Prompt Optimization (DSPy & TextGrad)
subskills.description: Programmatic prompt engineering and automated compiler optimization using DSPy (Signatures, Modules, Teleprompters like BootstrapFewShot, MIPRO) and gradient-like text optimization (TextGrad).

subskills.name: Prompt Evaluation & LLM-as-a-Judge Benchmarking
subskills.description: Evaluating prompt performance using LLM-as-a-Judge methodologies, pairwise comparison, automated prompt regression testing, and evaluation harness tools (Promptfoo, Langfuse).

subskills.name: Prompt Injection Resilience & Sandwich Defense
subskills.description: Hardening prompts against prompt injection, jailbreaking, and goal hijacking using sandwich defense, XML tag isolation, instruction-data separation, and output canary verification.

github.signal: LangChain or custom Jinja2 prompt templates with message structures
DSPy signatures, modules, and teleprompter compilation code
Promptfoo configuration or automated prompt evaluation scripts
Chain-of-thought, self-consistency, or XML delimited system prompts in code

cv.signal: Optimized production prompt pipelines using DSPy, MIPRO teleprompters, and Promptfoo regression suites
Architected complex prompt systems with Chain-of-Thought, Tree of Thoughts, and defensive formatting
Implemented few-shot in-context learning with dynamic exemplar retrieval and injection protection

Job experience describing DSPy prompt compilation, LLM-as-a-judge benchmarking, or reasoning chains

junior.description: Authors zero/few-shot prompts, designs reusable dynamic prompt templates, and enforces strict delimiter output formatting.

mid.description: Implements Chain-of-Thought and Tree of Thoughts reasoning architectures, and designs production enterprise metaprompts.
